skill.name: xhs-creator-profile-insights
skill.description: Look up Xiaohongshu (RedNote) creator profiles by account ID, profile link, or share text. Summarize visible account details and follower signals for initial partnership screening.
skill.summary: Summarize Xiaohongshu creator profiles and visible audience signals for initial research.
skill.author: devinchen2014

security_audit.summary: Most scanner alerts identify Markdown formatting, documentation links, or ordinary Chinese text rather than executable syntax or obfuscation. The CLI workflow runs an unpinned npm package with access to a SocialDataX credential. The instructions also lack safe shell argument handling, explicit approval for implicit billable calls, and verification of error-supplied billing links.

remediation.issue: Credentialed CLI calls execute a mutable npm release.
remediation.suggestion: Pin a reviewed release, verify package integrity, and require user approval before installing or updating it. Limit CLI credential access to a scoped key and prefer an operating system credential store over a JSON file.

remediation.issue: Shell examples do not specify how to bind user-supplied input safely.
remediation.suggestion: Pass profile input as one argument through a structured process API without shell evaluation. Use the configured MCP tool when safe argument binding is unavailable.

remediation.issue: Implicit invocation can consume SocialDataX credits.
remediation.suggestion: Require explicit approval for billable calls unless the user has already authorized the operation within a defined spending limit.

remediation.issue: Billing guidance prefers a link supplied by an error response.
remediation.suggestion: Use the fixed SocialDataX billing URL and present the rest of the error as text.

content.value_statement: Early partnership decisions are difficult when creator profile details and audience signals are scattered. This skill looks up a Xiaohongshu account and summarizes visible facts separately from screening judgments.
actual_capabilities: Look up a Xiaohongshu creator by a known account ID.
Accept a profile link, short link, or profile share text as an alternative to an account ID.
Summarize the returned nickname, account ID, biography, and verification status when available.
Report visible follower, following, and account like counts when the provider returns them.
Separate visible facts from initial screening judgments and suggest follow-up questions.
limitations: Each lookup accepts one creator identifier or profile input and covers one account.
Lookups require a working SocialDataX CLI credential or an authenticated SocialDataX MCP connection. Requests may consume provider credits.
Fields vary by account and provider response. Profile information does not establish audience demographics or campaign performance.
The skill looks up profiles only. It does not post, like, comment, or change account settings.

use_cases.title: Screen a Potential Partner
use_cases.description: Review a creator biography, verification status, and visible audience size before deciding whether to investigate a partnership.

use_cases.title: Check a Creator Roster Entry
use_cases.description: Look up a known Xiaohongshu account ID and check that the returned nickname and profile match the roster entry.

use_cases.title: Review Public Profile Positioning
use_cases.description: Summarize your profile biography and visible account signals. Identify questions to consider when refining your public positioning.

prompt_templates.title: Summarize a Profile
prompt_templates.prompt: Summarize the Xiaohongshu creator at [profile link]. List the nickname, biography, and follower count if returned.

prompt_templates.title: Verify a Known Account
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate: an account ID from a prior result.
prompt_templates.prompt: Look up Xiaohongshu account [account ID]. Report the nickname, verification status, and visible counts. Mark any unavailable fields.

prompt_templates.title: Screen for a Partnership
prompt_templates.scenario: Experienced: one creator and a campaign brief.
prompt_templates.prompt: Review [profile link] for a [campaign topic] partnership. Separate profile facts from fit judgments and list two questions to verify before outreach.

prompt_templates.title: Document a Screening Decision
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: explicit criteria and uncertain evidence.
prompt_templates.prompt: Assess Xiaohongshu account [account ID] against [screening criteria]. For each criterion, report the supporting profile field or mark it unverified. List the evidence needed before a decision.

output_examples.input: Illustrative request: Summarize the creator behind a Xiaohongshu profile link.
output: Profile facts: The creator describes the account as focused on home cooking. The profile shows 18,400 followers.
Unavailable: The response does not include verification status.
Next step: Review recent posts to confirm whether the current content matches the biography.

output_examples.input: Illustrative request: Screen a known Xiaohongshu account for a home organization campaign.
output: Profile facts: The biography mentions home storage. The profile shows 32,000 followers and 86,000 account likes.
Initial assessment: The stated topic is relevant. The account like count does not establish recent engagement.
Follow-up: Check recent posts and ask for audience data before outreach.

best_practices: Use the exact account ID when available. Otherwise, provide a complete profile link for one creator.
Mark missing fields as unavailable and label partnership judgments as preliminary.
Use an approved SocialDataX connection and confirm any billable lookup outside your existing authorization.
anti_patterns: Do not paste API keys into chat, prompts, or share text.
Do not treat follower and like totals as proof of audience fit or sales impact.
Do not repeatedly retry a request after the provider reports insufficient credits.

faq.question: What inputs can I use?
faq.answer: Use one Xiaohongshu account ID, profile URL, short link, or profile share text for each lookup.

faq.question: Can I look up a creator by nickname alone?
faq.answer: No. Use a supported profile link, share text, or account ID to identify the creator.

faq.question: Do I need to configure a local API key?
faq.answer: The CLI needs a SocialDataX API key. An already authenticated SocialDataX MCP connection can run lookups without separate local CLI credentials.

faq.question: Will every profile include verification status and metrics?
faq.answer: No. The report can summarize only the fields included in the provider response.

faq.question: Can the skill interact with the creator account?
faq.answer: No. Profile lookups are read-only and do not post, like, comment, or change account settings.

faq.question: What happens if my SocialDataX balance is insufficient?
faq.answer: Stop retries and check the account balance directly in the SocialDataX dashboard before trying again.
